feat(rtpllm): support Qwen4Exp prefix cache side states (#2717)

* feat(rtpllm): support Qwen4Exp prefix cache side states

* refactor(rtpllm): keep Qwen4Exp prefix PLE snapshots in plugin

* fix(rtpllm): handle empty prefix rows and verify PLE snapshots

* fix(rtpllm): harden Qwen4Exp prefix reuse and legacy AITER top-k

* perf(rtpllm): keep Qwen4Exp prefix checkpoint fast path in plugin

* fix(rtpllm): harden Qwen4Exp prefix checkpoint hooks

* refactor(rtpllm): use reuse_cache for Qwen4Exp side caches

* fix(rtpllm): harden prefix-cache contract tests for CPU CI
